questions_before_times: What it's for: a birthday, a school or shop event, a fair or festival, or a lesson
The date and the start and end time (the painting time is the party's hours)
Where: a home, a park, a school, a hall or another venue, and the town only (for the travel fee)
How many guests, and roughly their ages (it sets how many painters and how long)
Indoors, outdoors, or both (an outdoor party has a weather rule)
Add-ons: a second painter, glitter tattoos, extra time
safety_stop: A reaction now: swelling of the face, lips or throat, hives all over, or trouble breathing
Paint or glitter in the eye with pain or a change in sight
license: None for face painting in most places. A local business license where the city or county asks for one, and a permit for a public or outdoor event where the state's form or the venue asks for one.
staff_skills: ["Kids' parties","School and event face painting","Lessons","Glitter tattoos","Theme designs"]
messages_never: Allergies, skin conditions, past reactions, patch-test results and medical notes, and any child's name, age or notes, stay on the secure page and the painter's job link, never in a text to the host, the owner or the staff. A text says only 'a note is on the page'.
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
